# Agentory

> AI workforce for recruiting agencies — automates passive talent discovery, candidate intelligence, and outreach so recruiters make faster, smarter placements.

Agentory pairs specialized AI agents across sourcing, screening, growth, and intelligence with a single CRM, letting recruiting agencies run their pipeline with a small human team.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Agentory AI workforce and product ecosystem.
- [Features](/features): Precision sourcing, deep profile intelligence, CRM, email nurturing, and analytics.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starter, Growth, and Enterprise plans with a 14-day free trial.
- [Get a demo](/get-demo): Book a walkthrough with the team.
